services.name: Public Home
services.alerts: Hosting provider and public HTTP health
services.runner: Home repository hosting workflow; verify its current runner in GitHub
services.mutation: Use the Home repository workflow; never couple it to a Live Docker release.

services.name: Live and Ops
services.alerts: Harmonic Beacon operational alert channel and service health
services.runner: GitHub Actions self-hosted labels [self-hosted, mona], identity beacon-runner, restricted hb-deploy helper
services.mutation: Production changes only through the release workflow and restricted hb-deploy helper.

services.name: Beacon Account and Listener
services.alerts: Account/Listener readiness and paid-listener queue alerts
services.runner: Account/Listener-specific release path; do not infer the Live runner boundary
services.mutation: Use the Account/Listener release scripts and verify OIDC, cookies, logout, quota, membership and Authority contracts.

services.name: Tapestry, playlist and LiveKit media
services.alerts: Container health, LiveKit target monitor and media-specific alerts
services.runner: Live release runner for integrated production images; service-local tooling for focused diagnostics
services.mutation: Build, restart and roll back only the affected media service unless a shared contract requires more.

services.name: First-party Analytics
services.alerts: Local analytics monitor failure/recovery posts to the existing Alertmanager route; external recipient delivery remains unproven until a drill
services.runner: Externally provisioned analytics-production environment, analytics-delivery Mona runner label and root-owned hb-analytics-delivery helper
services.mutation: Keep analytics Compose/systemd lifecycle independent from Live; permit only exact-digest bounded helper operations and preserve product fail-open behavior.

services.name: Payments, membership Authority and PMP
services.alerts: Payment provider, membership authority and durable commerce queue alerts
services.runner: Unresolved until the canonical PMP/Authority owner and workflow are read back
services.mutation: Resolve the canonical owner repository, deployed SHA, database and runbook before mutation; sandbox only for payment tests.
